Meanwhile, Ukraine has grown more effective in its ability to conduct long-range strikes deep into Russia.

🚨 AI IS NOW BEING USED TO HACK BANKS.

CrowdStrike says a suspected China-based, financially motivated attacker used AI coding assistants + an AI-powered penetration-testing agent to breach multiple South Korean financial institutions.

The attacker reportedly used:

• 🇨🇳 ARTEX, an open-source agentic pentesting tool from China
 • 🤖 DeepSeek V4.1-Flash
 • 🧑‍💻 Claude Code
 • 🇨🇳 GLM-5.3
 • ✖️ Grok 4.6

The campaign targeted banks and financial services, with stolen data reportedly including customer information, income details and loan-limit data.

One exposed server allegedly contained Claude Code session histories and configuration files, giving researchers a rare look into how the attacker used AI during the campaign.

And this is the important part:
The AI didn't independently hack the banks.

A human operator directed the tools but AI appears to have helped automate and accelerate reconnaissance, coding and offensive security operations across multiple targets.

CrowdStrike says attribution to a specific hacking group remains unconfirmed.

But the bigger warning is clear:
Cyberattacks are becoming increasingly agentic.

AI isn't just helping defenders find vulnerabilities anymore.

Attackers are using it to find, exploit and scale them.

The cybersecurity arms race just entered a new phase. ⚠️
